title: Built a tool that creates full RPG character sheets in 30 seconds using Al
author: Its_Don
selftext:
You type something like "make a warrior who grew up
in a village" and it generates a full character sheet
with stats, bio, gear, personality, relationships, etc.
You can refine it by chat or manually tweak anything before exporting.

Figured it might be useful for making a bunch of
NPCs quickly.

Still refining the Ul and adding features, but it is live
now. Open to feedback. Hopefully it helps your guys' workflows.

replies.body: Hi it doesn't show character sheet or image , rest details are fine.

replies.author: Its_Don
replies.body:
Hmm. Maybe there's a bug somewhere that I need to fix, but to be sure, you confirmed that the sheet section was filled out after chatting, then clicked "Preview & Export"?

Regarding the image, you currently add your own by clicking the box and uploading. I'll try to work on image generation capabilities.

Thanks for trying it out, btw.

I've updated the detection logic and added safeguards to prevent premature exports.
